scope: Independent framework adequacy; no GPU execution or production ledger changes

verdict.kernel_loop: Substantial reproducible experiment framework; GPU pilot and first promotion still unproven. Remaining promotion gaps below.
verdict.optimizer_self_improvement: Specified but not implemented or validated; optimizer_method promotion correctly fails closed. Kernel tuning alone is not evidence of improved optimizer.
verdict.proj_rsi: Separate BF16 projection research scaffold; not equivalent to strict MoE ledger and not an optimizer-method evaluator.

strengths: Frozen objective, runtime image and measurement policy; immutable proposal/artifact hashes.
Independent critic/validator roles; actor labels explicitly not authentication.
Exact suite, finite raw samples, independent sessions and two fresh holdouts; correctness/report binding.
Shared cooperative GPU lease, admission budget, terminal proof required; local and serving claims separated.
Method promotion fails closed instead of interpreting one faster kernel as better search.

material_gaps.evidence: rsi/ledger.py:propose validates fixed anchor; validate_evidence compares supplied anchor samples; promote unconditionally replaces local_incumbent.
material_gaps.risk: A candidate better than original anchor but worse than current incumbent can replace incumbent.
material_gaps.required: Keep fixed-anchor progress measurement; separately require paired candidate-versus-current-incumbent comparison before replacement. Archive alternatives without replacement.

material_gaps.evidence: rsi/protocol.json:method_trial_contract status specified_not_implemented; rsi/ledger.py:validate_evidence rejects optimizer_method.
material_gaps.required: Implement frozen portfolio evaluator with disjoint task families, multiple independent search seeds, equal GPU/token budgets, fixed stopping, complete attempts including failures/compile time, independent portfolio-level decision. Do not enable method promotion on kernel-only evidence.

material_gaps.evidence: Q14-v4 pilot has no accepted complete control in reviewed ledger snapshot; state running with lease; root recovering failed lease.
material_gaps.required: Authoritative process/container termination then accounted recovery; fresh reviewed revision if runtime dependencies change; successful prespecified unchanged control before candidate. Never release from timeout alone.

material_gaps.evidence: measurement.py resamples adjacent AB/BA blocks; rsi ledger uses marginal per-shape bootstrap bounds over adaptive experiment sequence.
material_gaps.risk: Within-run bootstrap does not capture sustained thermal drift, across-day variation, or search-wide false discoveries. Two sessions improve replication but do not establish global95% confidence.
material_gaps.required: Predetermine maximum candidate confirmations and stopping/alpha policy or retain exploratory labels; add independent final replication across sessions. Avoid calling geomean of marginal bounds joint CI.

material_gaps.evidence: rsi/ledger.py:validate_evidence validates reference/empty-local/precision and provenance fields but does not itself enforce input_immutable_pass, actual imported/JIT identity or control report pass. Frozen executor and reviewer currently enforce these.
material_gaps.required: Bind successful control artifact and worker input/import/JIT/terminal evidence in validator schema; fail closed when absent. Human/agent attestation remains explicit until implemented.

material_gaps.evidence: rsi/protocol.json:ranking describes reranking and priors; ledger stores ROI prior but has no calibrated automatic policy evaluator.
material_gaps.required: Record predicted gain/cost, measured bottleneck share, realized gain/cost, failure categories and posterior uncertainty; use these for transparent reranking. This is engineering policy, not validated RSI until portfolio trial passes.

material_gaps.evidence: rsi/ledger.py:start consumes all proposal holdouts immediately. Reviewed ledger has31013/32003 consumed despite control-stage failure.
material_gaps.required: Use fresh seeds on next revision under current policy; never silently erase consumption. Any revised reservation/exposure semantics require explicit policy review and history preservation.

material_gaps.evidence: Protocol trusts local files/executors and common coordinator; shared filesystem agents can inspect holdouts and change evaluator.
material_gaps.required: Independent actual reviewer, full dependency completeness audit, external evaluator/access separation for stronger adversarial assurance; include node idle billing and agent costs when making efficiency claims.

proj_rsi_findings.relation: Dense projection challenge-specific score/protocol/ledger, separate results/proj-rsi; does not share strict rsi state machine or canonical GPU lease.

proj_rsi_findings.recommendation: Keep all proj_rsi results observational until strict provenance/raw measurement/finite checks/actor binding/locking/coordinator/correctness and loadwise gates are implemented. Reuse shared infrastructure with problem-specific score contract instead of treating weaker promotion as equivalent.

promotion_rules.kernel: Reviewed immutable implementation; clean successful control; exact suite correctness and inputs unchanged; fresh independently validated raw holdouts and source/runtime evidence; fixed-anchor gain AND current-incumbent replacement gate; only local component promotion.
promotion_rules.optimizer: Frozen control/challenger method snapshots; held-out task-family portfolio at matched total resources; all candidate attempts counted; all produced kernels independently satisfy unchanged gates; preregistered portfolio improvement decision by independent reviewer; no evaluator/objective weakening.
promotion_rules.goal: Separate fixed original-suite3x comparison; official serving agreement and latency/throughput curve remain independently required. No inference from projection/MoE microbenchmarks alone.
